world.description: A Japanese garden whose four quarters live in four seasons — switch them with 1–5.

lines: The maples turn the week the first frost comes. I just rake what they give me.
params.name: Haru

params.text: You take tea as the light goes. The garden is the same garden, in four coats.

lines: The garden changes its coat four times a year. Sit in each quarter, then come and take tea.
Tea tastes of whichever season you last stood in.
params.name: Aiko
params.persona: a calm elderly tea master who speaks in short, gentle sentences about the seasons

lines: The blossom here is better than the postcards.
params.name: Visitor

lines: I come every season. Never the same garden twice.
params.name: Visitor
params.persona: a visitor who loves the garden

hero-gazebo.description: Victorian octagonal gazebo, 4 m across corners, 4.6 m tall. Deck: raised octagon 0.5 m with skirt, 2 entry steps (0.17/0.33) on +Z face. 8 turned lathe columns 2.6 m tall at corners; eave beams 0.15 m; fretwork triangle brackets at beam ends; railing 0.9 m (bottom rail, 7 balusters, top rail) on 7 faces, open at entrance; 8-sided concave slate roof from 3.1 to 4.2 m with alternating shingle bands, overhang to 1.25R; finial ball, pole and weather-vane arrow to 4.6 m. White painted wood, slate roof.

intro.objective: Stand in each of the four quarters, then take tea at the tea house. Keys 1–5 turn the seasons.
intro.tagline: Blossom, green, fire and frost around one quiet koi pond.
intro.title: Four-Seasons Garden

world.name: Four-Seasons Garden

rules.description: Standing in the spring quarter counts it as seen

then.text: Spring: petals fall like slow snow on the water.

rules.description: Standing in the summer quarter counts it as seen

then.text: Summer: deep green, and the cicadas begin.

rules.description: Standing in the autumn quarter counts it as seen

then.text: Autumn: the maples burn without smoke.

rules.description: Standing in the winter quarter counts it as seen

then.text: Winter: frost on every branch, and the pond holds its breath.

rules.description: All four quarters seen: the tea house is open

then.text: You have seen all four seasons. Aiko is waiting at the tea house.

rules.description: Key 1: the whole garden in spring
Key 2: the whole garden in summer
Key 3: the whole garden in autumn
Key 4: the whole garden in winter
Key 5: all four seasons side by side

then.text: Walk the garden and stand in each quarter. Press 1–4 to change the season, 5 for all four.
